query: SELECT p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments, p.prosecdef AS security_definer, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS definition FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname IN ('schoolci_publish_notification', 'schoolci_log_admin_action') ORDER BY p.proname LIMIT 10;
